build_compression_model: build an EncodecModel compression model from a Hydra config with SEANet encoder, decoder, and RVQ quantizer
build_lm_model: build a transformer LM or MagnetLMModel from a Hydra config with conditioning providers and codebook patterns
build_jasco_model: build a FlowMatchingModel for JASCO audio generation from a Hydra config with conditioning and classifier-free guidance
build_watermark_model: build an AudioSeal watermark model from a Hydra config with SEANet encoder, decoder, and message processor
build_debug_models: build lightweight debug compression and LM models for unit testing with minimal parameters on CPU
